chapters: The word of Havayah which came to Hoshea the son of Beeri in the days of Uziyahu, Yotam, Achaz, and Chizkiyahu, kings of Yehudah, and in the days of Yeravam the son of Yoash king of Yisroel.
At the beginning of Havayah's speaking to Hoshea, Havayah said to Hoshea: Go, take yourself a wife of harlotry and children of harlotry, for the land goes astray from following Havayah.
And he went and took Gomer the daughter of Divlayim, and she conceived and bore him a son.
And Havayah said to him: Name him Yizreel, for, in a short time, I will visit the blood of Yizreel upon the house of Yehu, and I will terminate the kingdom of the house of Yisroel.
And it shall come to pass on that day that I will break the bow of Yisroel in the Valley of Yizreel.
And she conceived again and bore a daughter, and He said to him: Name her Lo-Ruchamah, for I will not continue to grant clemency to the house of Yisroel, but I will mete out their portion to them.
But to the house of Yehudah will I grant clemency, and I will save them by Havayah their Elokim, but I will not save them with the bow, with the sword, with war, with steeds, or with riders.
And she weaned Lo-Ruchamah, and she conceived and bore a son.
And He said: Name him Lo-Ami, for you are not My people, and I will not be yours.

And the number of the children of Yisroel shall be as the sand of the sea, which shall neither be measured nor counted; and it shall come to pass that, instead of saying to them, "You are not My people," it shall be said to them, "The children of the living Elokim."

And the children of Yehudah and the children of Yisroel shall be gathered together, and they shall appoint for themselves one head, and they shall go up from the land, for great is the day of Yizreel.
Say to your brethren, "Ammi," and to your sisters, "Ruhamah."
Strive with your mother, strive, for she is not My wife, and I am not her Husband, and let her remove her harlotries from her face and her adulteries from between her breasts.
Lest I strip her naked and leave her as on the day she was born; and I make her like a desert, and I set her like an arid land, and cause her to die of thirst.
And I will not pity her children for they are children of harlotries.

For their mother played the harlot; she who conceived them behaved shamefully, for she said, "I will go after my lovers, those who give my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drinks. "
Therefore, behold I will close off your way with thorns, and I make a fence against her, and she shall not find her paths.
And she shall pursue her lovers and not overtake them, and she shall seek them and not find them; and she shall say, "I will go and return to my first Husband, for it was better for me then than now.
But she did not know that I gave her the corn, the wine, and the oil, and I gave her much silver and gold, but they made it for Baal.
Therefore, I will return and take My corn in its time and My wine in its appointed season, and I will separate My wool and My flax, to cover her nakedness.
And now, I will bare her disgrace before the eyes of her lovers, and no man shall save her from My hand.
And I will terminate all her rejoicing, her festivals, her new moons, and her Shabbosos, and all her appointed seasons.

And I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees, concerning which she said, "They are my hire, which my lovers have given me," and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall devour them.
And I will visit upon her the days of the baalim, to whom she burnt incense, and she adorned herself with her earrings and her jewelry, and went after her lovers, and she forgot Me, Havayah says.
Therefore, behold I will allure her and lead her into the desert, and I will speak comfortingly to her heart.

And I will give her her vineyards from there and the depth of trouble for a door of hope, and she shall dwell there as in the days of her youth, and as the day of her ascent from the land of Mitzrayim.
And it shall come to pass on that day, Havayah says, you shall call Me Ishi, and you shall no longer call Me Baali.
And I will remove the names of the baalim from her mouth, and they shall no longer be mentioned by their name.

And I will make a covenant for them on that day with the beasts of the field and with the fowl of the sky and the creeping things of the earth; and the bow, the sword, and war I will break off the earth, and I will let them lie down safely.
And I will betroth you to Me forever, and I will betroth you to Me with righteousness and with justice and with loving-kindness and with mercy.
And I will betroth you to Me with faith, and you shall know Havayah.
And it shall come to pass on that day, that I will answer, Havayah says; I will answer the heavens, and they shall answer the earth.
And the earth shall answer the corn and the wine and the oil, and they shall answer Yizreel.
And I will sow her for Me in the land, and I will have compassion upon the unpitied one, and I will say to them that are not My people, "You are My people," and they shall say, "You are my Elokim."
And Havayah said to me: Go again, love a woman beloved by her companion, yet an adulteress, like the love of Havayah of the children of Yisroel, who turn to other gods, and love goblets of grapes.
And I bought her for me for fifteen pieces of silver, and a 'chomer' of barley and a 'lethech' of barley.
And I said to her: 'You shall remain as mine for many days; you shall not play the harlot, and you shall not belong to another man; so will I be towards you.
For the children of Yisroel shall remain for many days, having neither king, nor prince, nor sacrifice, nor pillar, nor ephod nor teraphim.
Afterwards shall the children of Yisroel return, and seek Havayah their Elokim and Dovid their king, and they shall come trembling to Havayah and to His goodness at the end of days.
Hear the word of Havayah, O children of Yisroel; for Havayah has a controversy with the inhabitants of the land; for there is neither truth nor loving-kindness nor knowledge of Elokim in the land.
There is swearing and lying and killing and stealing and committing adultery; they break all bounds, and blood touches blood.
Therefore shall the land mourn, and all that dwell therein shall be cut off, along with the beasts of the field, and the fowl of the heavens; also the fish of the sea shall be diminished.
Surely let no man strive, and let no man reprove; for your people are like them who strive with the priest.
Therefore you shall stumble in the daytime, and the prophet that is with you shall also stumble with you in the night, and I will silence your mother.

My people were silenced for lack of knowledge; because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you from being a priest to me; seeing that you have forgotten the Torah of your Elokim, I, too, will forget your children.
The more they have increased, the more they have sinned against Me; I will (therefore) exchange their honor for shame.
They feed on the sin offerings of My people, and set their heart on their inquity.
And it shall be like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and requite them for their deeds.
For they shall eat, and not be satisfied; they shall commit harlotry and shall not increase; because they have forsaken Elokim to take heed of His ways.
Harlotry and old wine and new wine take away the heart.
My people takes counsel of his piece of wood, and his rod declares to him. For the spirit of harlotry has caused them to err, and they have gone astray lewdly from under their Elokim.

They sacrifice upon the mountaintops and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and styraxes and elms, because its shadow is good; therefore your daughters commit harlotry, and your daughters — in-law commit adultery.

I will not punish your daughters when they commit harlotry, nor your daughters — in-law when they commit adultery; for they themselves join with harlots, and they sacrifice with the prostitutes; therefore the people that do not understand shall be knocked about.
Though you, O Yisroel, play the harlot, let not Yehudah also become guilty; and do not come to Gilgal, nor go up to Beis-Aven, nor swear, 'As Havayah lives.'
For Yisroel has rebelled like a rebellious cow; now shall Havayah feed them as a lamb in a broad pasture area.
Efraim is joined to idols; let him alone.
Their drinking bouts have become strange; they have led them to harlotry; her rulers love to invite disgrace upon them.
The wind has bound her up in its wings, and they shall be ashamed of their altars.
Hear this, O priests; and hearken, O house of Yisroel; and give ear, O house of the king; for yours is the judgment, because you have been a snare on Mitzpah, and a net spread upon Tavor.
The extent of their straying they have deepened, and I will bring chastisement to all of them.
I knew Efraim, and Yisroel was not hidden from Me, for now you have committed harlotry, O Efraim; Yisroel was defiled.
They do not abandon their deeds to return to their Elokim, for a spirit of harlotries is within them, and they do not know Havayah.
And the pride of Yisroel shall be humbled before them, and Yisroel and Efraim shall stumble over their iniquity, and Yehudah too shall stumble with them.
With their flocks and with their cattle, they shall go to seek Havayah, but they shall not find Him; He has withdrawn from them.
They betrayed Havayah for they begot strange children; now a month shall consume them with their fields.
Sound a shofar in Givah, a trumpet in Ramah; shout in Beis-Aven, "After you, Binyamin!"
Efraim shall be bewildered on the day of contention; among the tribes of Yisroel I made known the true doctrine.
The princes of Yehudah were like those who remove the landmark; upon them will I pour My wrath like water.
Efraim is plundered, broken by judgment, because he desired and followed a command.
And I am like a moth to Efraim and like decay to the house of Yehudah.
And Efraim saw his ailment, and Yehudah his pain, and Efraim went to Ashur, and he sent to the king of Yarev, but he will not be able to heal you, and he will not remove the pain from you.
For I am like a young lion to Efraim and like a lion's whelp to the house of Yehudah; I, yea I, will tear and I will go away; I will carry off and no one will rescue.
I will go away and return to My place until they admit their guilt and seek My face; in their straits they will seek Me.
Come and let us return to Havayah, for He has torn and He shall heal us; He smites, and He will bind us up.
He will revive us from the two days, on the third day He will set us up, and we will live before Him.
And let us know, let us strive to know Havayah: like the dawn whose going forth is sure, and He will come to us like rain, like the latter rain which satisfies the earth.
What shall I do for you, Efraim? What shall I do for you, Yehudah? For your loving-kindness is like a morning cloud and like the dew that passes away early.
Because I have hewed by the prophets, I have put them to death because of the words of My mouth; now will your verdicts come out to the light?
For I desire loving-kindness, and not sacrifices, and knowledge of Elokim more than burnt offerings.
But they, like Adam, transgressed the covenant; there they betrayed Me.
Gilad is a city of workers of them that work iniquity, who lurk to shed blood.
And as a man gathers fish, so do bands; a gang of priests murder on the way in one group, for they devised a plot.
In the house of Yisroel I have seen a horrible thing: there, harlotry is found in Efraim; Yisroel has become defiled.
Yehudah, too, there is a harvest appointed to you, when I will return the backsliding of My people.
When I would heal Yisroel, the iniquity of Efraim and the evils of Shomron are revealed, for they commit falsehood, and a thief comes, and a troop makes a raid without.
They do not say in their heart that I remember all their evil. Now their deeds have surrounded them; they were before My face.
With their evil, they make the king glad, and with their lies, princes.
They are all adulterers like an oven heated by the baker; the arouser rests from kneading the dough until it leavens.
The day of our king, the princes became ill from the heat of the wine; he withdrew his hand with the scorners.
For they have made ready their heart like an oven with their ambush; all night their baker sleeps, in the morning he burns like a flaming fire.
They are all heated like an oven and they devour their judges; all their kings have fallen, none of them calls out to Me.
Efraim mingles with the peoples; Efraim was as a cake which was not turned over.
Strangers have consumed his strength, but he did not know; also weakness was cast into him, but he did not know.
And the pride of Yisroel was humbled before him, and they did not return to Havayah their Elokim, and did not seek Him despite this.
And Efraim was like a silly dove without a heart; they called upon Mitzrayim, they went to Ashur.
When they go, I will spread My net over them; like the fowl of the heaven I will bring them down. I will chastise them as I let their congregation hear.
Woe is to them for they have wandered away from Me; plunder to them for they have rebelled against Me. I would redeem them, but they spoke lies about Me.
And they did not cry out to Me with their heart, therefore they will wail on their beds; because of the corn and the wine which they store up, they turn away from Me.
But I chastised them, I strengthened their arms, yet to Me they attribute evil.
They will return, but to no avail; they were like a deceitful bow; their princes shall fall by the sword, from the fury of their tongue. This is their derision in the land of Mitzrayim.
To your palate a shophar: Like an eagle upon the house of Havayah, for they have transgressed My covenant and they have rebelled against My Law.
To Me Yisroel will cry: "My Elokim! We know You!"
Yisroel has cast off the Good One; the enemy shall pursue him.
They set up a king, but not from Me, they removed, and I did not know; with their silver and their gold they made themselves idols, in order that it be cut off.
He has forsaken you because of your calf, O Shomron, My wrath is kindled against them; how long will they be unable to cleanse themselves?
For it is from Yisroel; a craftsman made it, and it is a no — deity, for the calf of Shomron shall be splinters.
For they sow wind and they will reap the tempest; it has no standing grain, a plant that will not produce flour; if it does produce, strangers will swallow it.
Yisroel has been swallowed; now they are among the nations as a useless utensil.
For they went up to Ashur, a wild donkey secluded to himself, they paid hire for love.
Although they pay hire among the nations, now I will gather them, and they will be humbled a little from the burden of the king and the princes.
For Efraim has increased altars to sin; he had altars to sin.
I write for them the great things of My Law; like a strange thing they are considered.

As for the sacrifices they burn before Me, let them slaughter the flesh and eat it; Havayah does not desire them. Now He will remember their iniquity and visit their sins when they return to Mitzrayim.
Yisroel has forgotten his Maker, and has built temples, and Yehudah has increased fortified cities, and I will set fire to his cities, and it will consume her palaces.
Rejoice not, O Yisroel, on joyous occasions, like the peoples, for you have strayed from your Elokim: you love a harlot's hire on all threshingfloors of corn.
The threshingfloor and the wine cellar shall not feed them, and fresh wine shall fail her.
They shall not stay in the land of Havayah, but Efraim shall return to Mitzrayim, and in Ashur they shall eat unclean food.

They shall not pour libations of wine to Havayah, they will not please Him; their sacrifices are like bread of mourners to them, all those who partake thereof become contaminated, for their bread is for themselves, it should not come into the house of Havayah.
What will you do for the appointed day and for the day of Havayah's massacre?
For behold, they have gone away because of plunder, Mitzrayim shall gather them, Mof shall bury them; the treasurehouses for their silver — thistles shall inherit them, briers in their dwellings.

The days of the visitation have arrived; the days of recompense have arrived, let Yisroel know; the prophet shall be a fool, the man of the spirit mad; this is because of your great iniquity, and the hatred is great.
Efraim is a prophet with my Elokim, for the prophet they lay a fowler's snare on all his ways, causing hatred in the house of his Elokim.
They have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of Givah; He shall remember their iniquity, He shall visit their sins.

Like grapes in the desert I found Yisroel, like a ripe fig on a fig tree, in its beginning, I saw your forefathers; they came to Baal-Peor, and they separated themselves to a shameful thing, and they became detestable when they loved..
As for Efraim — their honor shall fly away like a bird; from birth, from the womb, or from conception.
For, if they raise their children, I will bereave them before they become men, for woe to them also when I turn away from them.
Efraim, as I saw Tzor, is planted in a dwelling place, but Efraim is busy taking his children out to the slayer.
Give them, O Havayah, what you will give; give them a bereaving womb and dry breasts.
All their evil is in Gilgal, for there I hated them; for the evil of their deeds, I will drive them from My house; I will not continue to love them, all their princes are rebellious.
Efraim has been smitten, their root is dry, they shall not produce fruit; even when they give birth, I will slay the precious ones of their womb.
My Elokim shall reject them because they did not obey Him, and they shall be wandering among the nations.
Yisroel is a vine devoid of fruit fitting for it. When I increased their good, they increased for the altars; when I increased for their land, they increased pillars.
Their heart has parted; now they shall be desolate. That shall demolish their altars, plunder their pillars.
For now they shall say, "We have no king, for we did not fear Havayah; now what shall the king do for us?"
They spoke words, swearing falsely, forming a covenant, and judgment shall spring up like hemlock on the furrows of the field.

Because of the calves of Beis-Aven, the neighbors in Shomron shall be frightened, for its people shall mourn over it, and its priests, would rejoice over it, because of its glory, for it has been exiled from it.
That too shall be carried off to Ashur, a gift to King Yarev; Efraim shall take shame, and Yisroel shall be ashamed of his counsel.
The king of Shomron is silenced and is like foam on the surface of the water.
The high places of Aven are destroyed, the sin of Yisroel; thorns and thistles shall come up on their altars, and they shall say to the mountains, "Cover us up," and to the hills, "Fall upon us."
Since the days of Givah, you have sinned, O Yisroel! There they remained; the battle against the haughty did not overtake them in Givah.
With My will, I chastised them, and nations shall gather about them, when they bind them to their two eyes.
And Efraim is a goaded heifer that loves to thresh, and I passed over her fair neck; I will cause Efraim to ride, Yehudah shall plow, Yackov shall break his clods.
Sow righteousness for yourselves, reap according to loving-kindness, plow yourselves a plowing, and it is time to seek Havayah, until He comes and instructs you in righteousness.
You have plowed wickedness, you have reaped injustice, you have eaten fruit of lies, for you have relied on your way, on the abundance of your mighty men.

And a tumult shall rise in your peoples, and all your fortresses shall be plundered, as the plunder of a peaceful people by an ambush on a day of war; the mother with the children was dashed to pieces.
So has Beis El done to you because of the evil of your wickedness; at dawn, the king of Yisroel has been silenced.
For, when Yisroel was young, I loved him, and from Mitzrayim I called My son.
The more they called out to them, the more they went away from them; to the baalim they would slaughter sacrifices, and to the graven images they would burn incense.
But I sent to train Efraim, he took them on his arms, but they did not know that I healed them.
I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love, and I was to them like those who lift the yoke on their bridles, and I extended to him the ability to bear.
He shall not return to the land of Mitzrayim, but Ashur is his king, for they have refused to repent.
And a sword shall rest in his cities, and it shall destroy his branches, and it shall consume; because of their counsels.
And My people waver whether to return to Me, and to the matter concerning which they call them, together they do not uphold it.
How shall I give you, Efraim? How deliver you, O Yisroel? How shall I make you as Admah, make you as Tzevoyim? My heart is turned within Me, together My remorse has been kindled.
I will not execute the kindling of My anger, I will not return to destroy Efraim, for I am Elokim and not a man. In your midst is the Holy One, and I will not enter a city.
They shall follow Havayah, He shall roar like a lion; for He shall roar, and the children shall hasten from the west.
They shall hasten like a bird from Mitzrayim and like a dove from the land of Ashur; and I will place them in their houses, Havayah says.
Efraim has surrounded me with lies, and the house of Yisroel with deceit, but Yehudah still rules with Elokim, and with the Holy One he is faithful.
Efraim joins the wind and chases the east wind; all day he increases deceit and plunder, and they make a treaty with Ashur, and oil is brought to Mitzrayim.
Now Havayah has a contention with Yehudah, and to visit upon Yackov according to his ways; according to his deeds He shall recompense him.
In the womb, he seized his brother's heel, and with his strength he strove with an angel.
He strove with an angel and prevailed; he wept and beseeched him; In Beis El he shall find Him, and there He shall speak with us.
And Havayah is the Elokim of the hosts; Havayah is His Name.
And you shall return by your Elokim: keep loving-kindness and justice, and hope to your Elokim always.
A trafficker who has deceitful scales in his hand; he loves to oppress.
And Efraim said: Surely I have become rich; I have found power for myself; all my toils shall not suffice for my iniquity which is sin.
And I am Havayah your Elokim from the land of Mitzrayim; I will yet make you dwell in tents as in the days of the early times.
And I spoke to the prophets, and I increased their visions; and to the prophets I assumed likenesses.
If there is violence in Gilad, it is because they were but vanity; in Gilgal they sacrificed oxen; also their altars were like heaps on the furrows of the field.
And Yackov fled to the field of Aram; and Yisroel worked for a wife, and for a wife he guarded.
And, through a prophet, Havayah brought up Yisroel from Mitzrayim, and through a prophet they were guarded.
Efraim provoked, yea bitterness; therefore his blood shall be cast upon him, and his disgrace his Havayah shall requite upon him.
When Efraim spoke with trembling, he became exalted in Yisroel; when he became guilty through Baal, he died.

And now, they continue to sin, and they have made for themselves a molten image from their silver according to their pattern, deities, all of it the work of craftsmen; to them say, "Those who sacrifice man may kiss the calves."
Therefore, they shall be like a morning cloud, and like dew that passes away early, like chaff that is driven with the wind out of the threshing floor, and like smoke out of a chimney.
And I am Havayah your Elokim from the land of Mitzrayim, and gods besides Me you should not know, and there is no savior but Me.
I knew you in the desert, in a land of deprivation.
When they grazed and were sated, they were sated and their heart became haughty; therefore, they forgot Me.
And I was to them as a lion, as a leopard by the way I will lurk.
I will meet them as a bereaving bear, and I will rend the enclosure of their heart, and I will devour them as a lion, the beast of the field shall rend them asunder.
You have destroyed yourself, O Yisroel, for you have rebelled against Me, against your help.
I will be, where is your king? Now let him save you in all your cities, and your judges, concerning whom you said, "Give me a king and princes."
I gave you a king with My wrath and I took him away with My fury.
The iniquity of Efraim is bound up; his sin is laid away.
Pangs of a woman in confinement shall come to him: he is an unwise son, for it is a time that he shall not stand in the birthstool of the children.
From the clutches of the grave I would ransom them, from death I would redeem them; I will be your words of death; I will decree the grave upon you. Remorse shall be hidden from My eyes.

For though he flourish among the marshes, an east wind shall come, a wind of Havayah, ascending from the desert, and his spring shall dry up, and his fountain shall be parched; he shall plunder the treasure of all coveted vessels.
Shomron shall be accounted guilty, for she has rebelled against her Elokim: they shall fall by the sword, their infants shall be dashed, and their pregnant women shall be ripped up.
Return, O Yisroel, to Havayah your Elokim, for you have stumbled in your iniquity.
Take words with yourselves and return to Havayah. Say, "You shall forgive all iniquity and teach us the good way, and let us render for bulls the offering of our lips.
Ashur shall not save us; we will not ride on horses, nor will we say any longer, our gods, to the work of our hands, for in You, by Whom the orphan is granted mercy."
I will remedy their backsliding; I will love them freely, for My wrath has turned away from them.
I will be like dew to Yisroel, they shall blossom like a rose, and it shall strike its roots like the Levanon.
Its branches shall go forth, and its beauty shall be like the olive tree, and its fragrance like the Levanon.
Those who dwelt in its shade shall return; they shall revive like corn and blossom like the vine; its fragrance shall be like the wine of Levanon.
Efraim; What more do I need the images? I will answer him and I will look upon him: I am like a leafy cypress tree; from Me your fruit is found.
Who is wise and will understand these, discerning and will know them; for the ways of Havayah are straight, and the righteous shall walk in them, and the rebellious shall stumble on them.
